mechanism: A Coxeter element of W(E8) rotates a unique (up to W-action) plane by 2pi/30. Orthogonal projection onto that plane is the portrait.
assumptions: Coxeter element is the product of one simple reflection per Dynkin node.
confusion_guard: The plane is a drawing aid. It is not a physical slice and not a dual of m = hf/c^2.
